stem: 信托和公司服务提供商（TCSPs）提供的哪些服务存在最大的金融犯罪风险？（选择三项。）

options.A: 提供明确的程序以确保遵守当地税收法规
options.B: 利用信托掩盖受益所有人的身份
options.C: 推广使用复杂的公司结构
options.D: 为所有注册其服务的客户维护准确且最新的受益所有权详情
options.E: 设立空壳公司以持有金融资产

stem_en: Which of the services provided by Trust and Company Service Providers (TCSPs) present the greatest financial crime risks? (Choose three.)

options_en.A: Providing clear procedures to ensure compliance with local tax regulations
options_en.B: Using trusts to obscure the identity of beneficial owners
options_en.C: Promoting the use of complex corporate structures
options_en.D: Maintaining accurate and updated beneficial ownership details for all customers registered for their services
options_en.E: Establishing shell companies for holding financial assets
